notes.title: English translation is out
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we've added English user interface support after few days of work.

But we still have many localization problem needs to be resolved, we will keep updating in the future.
Still, this will take time. We have decided to rewrite our user interface system, hopefully resolve this problem once and for all.

notes.title: English translation is coming
notes.notes:
Yes, we know everyone needs english.
Currently we have some issues with language detection, our programmer is working very hard to solve this.
Another problem is the text in the game's UI & tutorials are all actually images so we would have to remake all of them, and this may takes some time.

Please be patient, the partial english support will come before our programmer's holiday time runs out.

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
We have received many feedback after release, so we starting to improve our game.
But this is a vary big task for us, we plan to reconstruct the game map and adjust game play.
Our programmer have 7 days off from military service during Chinese new year, so we can upgrade our game engine to the latest version. And hopefully adding some new features.
Since we are unable to keep our team running due to financial problems, we decided
to make our studio a part-time job temporarily.
It may slow down the updates unfortunately, but at very least keeps our studio alive.
Even it will take very long for us to finally complete this game, we still hope everyone can enjoy it and give us more feedback to improve it.


The next game project will be launched when we got enough resources. Keeping an eye on our fan page and official website to get the latest news.

notes.title: Important note
notes.notes:
Just to clarify, this game is kind of a 15 to 30 minutes long single player demo. It's not a pay to win grinding game and it may be very buggy. Just like we said in the description, "this game's main focus is to show how much we're capable to do at a short period of time, but since we thought the result wasn't actually sellable, we decided to release this game for free.  " This is a student project, in our current situation it is impossible to make this into a full game(money, man power, military service, etc... ). This game will stay as it is, but in the future when we finally have the resource we will make something new(hopefully a full game), but no timeline guarantees.

Still, feedbacks are much appreciated.
